note: Forbidden: a transport connection on which the router does not speak first with a Reset or Serial Query. TestFirstPDUOnConnectionIsAQuery accepts the connection at a real listener and require.NoError on io.ReadFull of the first PDU (a silent router times out), then asserts buf[1] == pduResetQuery for a fresh session and pduSerialQuery for a resuming one. Row carries {single-polarity: positive}.
